outlooks.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE...PRIMARILY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...FROM THE GREAT LAKES AND MID-ATLANTIC STATES SOUTHWEST TO THE OZARK PLATEAU AND WEST TO THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR S CENTRAL MT
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... WIDELY SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE...PRIMARILY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...FROM THE GREAT LAKES AND MID-ATLANTIC STATES SOUTHWEST TO THE OZARK PLATEAU AND WEST TO THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL PROGRESS EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS LOWER MI...IN CONJUNCTION WITH AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE COLD FRONT THAT IS NOW NEAR THE W SHORE OF LAKE MI. THUNDERSTORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS ASCENT AND DAYTIME HEATING/MIXING REMOVE ANY LINGERING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. MODERATE BUOYANCY IS EXPECTED IN THE WARM SECTOR ACROSS LOWER MI WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS MAINLY IN THE 60S AND SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 70S TO MID 80S. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED SHORT LINE SEGMENTS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. STORM COVERAGE IS MORE UNCERTAIN WITH SWD EXTENT TOWARD NRN INDIANA...SINCE THIS AREA WILL RESIDE IMMEDIATELY S OF THE HEIGHT FALLS AND FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THE WI/LOWER MI SHORTWAVE TROUGH. STILL...IF STORMS FORM...MODERATE BUOYANCY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AOA 40 KT WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR SPLITTING SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL. A MARGINAL WIND/HAIL RISK WILL ALSO EXTEND WWD INTO NE WI...WHERE LINGERING LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND DAYTIME HEATING WILL MAINT

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEY REGION TO NC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: AN MCV FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION AND ASSOCIATED CONVECTIVE CLUSTER ARE MOVING GENERALLY EWD OVER THE OH RIVER NEAR THE INDIANA/KY/OH BORDER AS OF LATE MORNING. THIS CONVECTION WILL POSE A RISK FOR OCCASIONAL DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS AND HAIL. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ALSO EXPECTED TO THE SW THIS AFTERNOON INTO SRN KY AND TN ALONG THE DIFFUSE OUTFLOW FROM THE MORNING CONVECTION. THESE STORMS SHOULD SUBSEQUENTLY SPREAD EWD/ESEWD AND POTENTIALLY REACH WRN NC THIS AFTERNOON. SCATTERED DAMAGING GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY RISK WITH ANOTHER CLUSTER OF STORMS GIVEN THE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND SOME ENHANCEMENT OF LOW-MIDLEVEL FLOW WITH THE MCV.

sections.title: OK AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: THE EFFECTIVE FRONT IS DENOTED BY THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS CENTRAL OK...TRAILING WWD FROM THE WEAKENING NE OK STORMS...AND REINFORCED INTO NW OK/TX PANHANDLE BY THE SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT. DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG THE S EDGE OF THE THICKER CLOUDS AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT MODERATE-STRONG BUOYANCY AND THE POTENTIAL FOR RENEWED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: ERN CO THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW AND LINGERING BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 55-60 F RANGE WILL SUPPORT MODERATE BUOYANCY AND THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT NEAR OR IMMEDIATELY E OF THE FRONT RANGE THIS AFTERNOON. ..THOMPSON/LEITMAN.. 07/08/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE MORE LIKELY FROM SOUTHEAST KENTUCKY AND SOUTHERN WEST VIRGINIA INTO SOUTHWEST VIRGINIA...WESTERN NORTH CAROLINA AND NORTHEAST TENNESSEE. OTHER WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM THE GREAT LAKES AND MID-ATLANTIC STATES SOUTHWEST TO THE OZARK PLATEAU AND WEST TO THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS. SEVERAL OUTLOOK AREAS HAVE BEEN MODIFIED TO ACCOUNT FOR CURRENT TRENDS. THIS INCLUDES LOWER MI WHERE SEVERE STORMS ARE PROGRESSING STEADILY TOWARD LAKE HURON INDICATING THE ENH RISK AREA CAN BE REMOVED. IN ADDITION...THE ENH RISK AREA OVER THE CENTRAL APPALACHIAN REGION HAS BEEN ENLARGED SLIGHTLY TO INCLUDE MORE OF SWRN VA THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. OTHERWISE...THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE INCREASING FROM NERN AR AND SERN MO EWD TOWARD WRN PARTS OF KY AND TN AS STORMS ARE INTENSIFYING IN ADVANCE OF AN EWD MOVING MCV OVER SWRN MO /SEE LATEST WW 359/. AMPLE MOISTURE/INSTABILITY PERSISTS IN AN ARC FROM THE MID-SOUTH WWD ACROSS OK AND NWWD INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...AND SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE IN THESE AREAS. THUS...ONLY MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE OUTLOOK IN THESE AREAS. ..WEISS.. 07/08/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS WITH GUSTY WINDS AND SMALL HAIL WILL SPREAD TOWARD THE IND/OH/KY BORDER REGION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANTS OF THURSDAY NIGHT MCS THAT DEVELOPED OVER ERN KS/WRN MO HAVE SPREAD INTO SERN IL/SRN IND/NWRN KY. LONGER REFLECTIVITY LOOPS SUGGEST A WEAK MCV IS LOCATED NW OF EVV AND THIS MAY BE PARTLY RESPONSIBLE FOR UPWARD EVOLUTION OF CONVECTION IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM. WHILE BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR MASS HAS YET TO DESTABILIZE APPRECIABLY ALONG THE OH RIVER CORRIDOR...BACKGROUND SUPPORT FOR STRONG CONVECTION APPEARS TO BE IN PLACE. SMALL THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE LIKELY TO CONTINUE AS THEY PROPAGATE TOWARD THE IND/OH/KY BORDER REGION. WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR FOR POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND SMALL HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THUNDERSTORMS THIS MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BUT TIMING IS UNCERTAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT STRETCHING FROM THE CENTRAL UPPER PENINSULA SOUTHWARD THROUGH LAKE MICHIGAN INTO CENTRAL IL. THESE STORMS WILL MAINLY AFFECT PORTIONS OF NORTHERN LOWER MI THROUGH MIDDAY. WITH CONTINUED HEATING...INCREASING DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED AND WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S TO NEAR 70...MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500-2000 J/KG ARE POSSIBLE WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS MARGINALLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS AND A MIX OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND MARGINAL SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE. THE MAIN THREAT APPEARS TO BE DAMAGING WINDS DUE IN PART TO WATER LOADING AFFECTS WITH PW VALUES NOTED IN THE 1.25-1.5 INCH RANGE. AS TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE LOW 80S...LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ALSO INCREASE...FURTHER SUPPORTING DOWNBURST POTENTIAL. STORMS MAY REMAIN FAIRLY ISOLATED THIS MORNING BEFORE BECOMING MORE WIDESPREAD WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPPER SHORTWAVE IMPULSE AND EASTWARD SURGE OF THE COLD FRONT. WHILE A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED AT SOME POINT IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...TIMING IS UNCERTAIN AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOOSELY-ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/HAIL RISK MAY PERSIST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS NE OK AND POSSIBLY NW AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ONGOING THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER OVER NE OK HAS PRODUCED A FEW LARGE HAIL AND MARGINALLY-SEVERE THUNDERSTORM GUSTS DURING THE PAST HOUR. THE CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES HAVE NOT BEEN PARTICULARLY ORGANIZED/PERSISTENT...THOUGH REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS REVEALED MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 8 C/KM AND SUFFICIENT LOW-MIDLEVEL MOISTURE TO MAINTAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR NEW STRONG UPDRAFTS IN THE CLUSTER. TO THIS POINT...LOW-LEVEL WAA HAS LIKELY PLAYED A PRIMARY ROLE IN STORM DEVELOPMENT...SO WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL FLOW THROUGH LATE MORNING AND SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION FOR SURFACE PARCELS CAST DOUBT ON THE FUTURE EVOLUTION OF THE STORMS. A WATCH PROBABLY WILL NOT BE NEEDED IN THE SHORT TERM...BUT WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR FOR MORE SURFACE-BASED DEVELOPMENT POTENTIAL TOWARD MIDDAY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES WITH DAYTIME HEATING. ..THOMPSON.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS SERN KY INTO MIDDLE TN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY-LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO AN EXPANDING/DEEPENING CU FIELD FROM ERN KY...SWWD INTO MIDDLE TN. LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS SEVERAL ROBUST UPDRAFTS ARE ATTEMPTING TO PENETRATE LEVELS WHERE GLACIATION WILL BE INDUCED. 12Z SOUNDING FROM BNA EXHIBITED VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...8 C/KM...AND DEEP-LAYER FLOW SHOULD INCREASE SUCH THAT ORGANIZED CONVECTION IS EXPECTED. AS CONVECTION EVOLVES...ESEWD PROPAGATION SHOULD RESULT IN TSTM COMPLEX MOVING TOWARD WRN NC BY EARLY EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO EARLY EVENING. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS RESIDES OVER THE OZARK PLATEAU INTO THE MID-MS VALLEY REGION. CURRENT MESOANALYSIS SUGGEST AN UNCAPPED AIRMASS WITH WIDESPREAD SBCAPE VALUES GREATER THAN 3000 J/KG. A SURFACE COLD FRONT WAS LOCATED FROM CENTRAL IL TO JUST NORTH OF THE ST. LOUIS METRO AREA INTO WEST-CENTRAL MO. A WEAK MCV AND ASSOCIATED CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS WAS LOCATED NEAR BRANSON IN SW MO AND TRACKING TOWARD THE E/NE. AHEAD OF THE MCV...WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WERE ALSO DEVELOPING. DEEP LAYER FLOW IS RELATIVELY WEAK...GENERALLY 30 KT OR LESS. THIS WILL IMPACT OVERALL STORM ORGANIZATION...BUT STRONG INSTABILITY MAY SUPPORT BRIEF...INTENSE UPDRAFTS. STEEP MID AND LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ALSO AID IN HAIL PRODUCTION AS WELL AS STRONG DOWNBURSTS. THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT COULD INCREASE/BECOME MORE WIDESPREAD SHOULD THUNDERSTORM INTERACTIONS LEAD TO A COLD POOL AND SUBSEQUENT FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS. THIS SCENARIO REMAINS UNCERTAIN AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT WILL SPREAD SOUTHEAST ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN VA/NC INTO THE EVENING. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF CONVECTION ACROSS SRN WV HAS SHOWN SIGNS OF MAINTAINING FORWARD PROPAGATION AND SEVERE WIND THREAT LATE THIS AFTERNOON. THIS CLUSTER OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE TRACKING E/SE INTO PARTS OF WRN VA/NC WHERE A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS RESIDES WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S. WHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR IS MODEST...DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND STEEP MID AND LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT INTO THE EVENING HOURS. IN PARTICULAR...THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY INCREASE JUST TO THE EAST OF THE MOUNTAINS WHERE TEMPERATURES WERE IN THE 90S AND LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES/DCAPE INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY. AS SUCH...A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 357 IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF LOWER MI.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT ACROSS PORTIONS OF LOWER MI THIS AFTERNOON. INTENSE CELLS WERE NOTED OVER MIDLAND AND BAY COUNTIES AS WELL AS FURTHER NORTH OVER IOSCO AND ALCONA COUNTIES. FURTHER SOUTHWEST INTO PORTIONS OF SRN LOWER MI...MORE ROBUST DEVELOPMENT WAS STRUGGLING IN THE ABSENCE OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW ENTERING NORTHERN LOWER MI. THIS IMPULSE WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK E/NE THROUGH THE EVENING. STRONG INSTABILITY...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR GREATER THAN 40 KT IS MORE THAN SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE TRAILING COLD FRONT. DEVELOPMENT MAY BECOME MORE WIDESPREAD AS THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THE UPPER SHORTWAVE MOVES OVER THE AREA INTO THE EVENING. ..LEITMAN.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MCS IS GRADUALLY EVOLVING AND SHOULD GENERATE STRONG WINDS AS IT PROPAGATES SEWD TOWARD THE HIGHER TERRAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOOPY SQUALL LINE HAS EVOLVED FROM SRN WV...WWD ACROSS CNTRL KY INTO EXTREME NRN TN. A GRADUALLY EXPANDING PRECIP SHIELD/COLD POOL IS LIKELY TO AID A STRENGTHENING MCS AS IT BEGINS TO TURN SEWD AND POTENTIALLY INCREASE IN FORWARD SPEED. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVES INTO THE HIGHER TERRAIN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE INTO THE EVENING HOURS. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED...THOUGH TIMING IS UNCERTAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING ALONG A COLD FRONT IN WEST-CENTRAL OK AND FURTHER SOUTHWEST INTO THE TX PANHANDLE/SOUTH PLAINS. DEWPOINTS MAINLY IN THE 70S /SOMEWHAT LOWER IN THE PANHANDLE/ AND STRONG HEATING HAVE RESULTED IN STRONG INSTABILITY. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ON THE LOW END FOR SUPERCELLS...AROUND 35 KT OR LESS. BUT STEEP MID AND LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES COMBINED WITH MLCAPE GREATER THAN 3500 J/KG SHOULD ALLOW FOR AT LEAST LOOSELY/BRIEFLY ORGANIZED INTENSE UPDRAFTS. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS WW 359...AND WILL SPREAD INTO WRN TN AND SWRN KY WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS SHOW INCREASING CONVECTION WITHIN THE PAST 1-2 HRS IN ASSOCIATION WITH A MCV MOVING THROUGH THE OZARK PLATEAU. CHARACTER OF ONGOING TSTMS HAS REMAINED ONLY WEAKLY ORGANIZED THUS FAR...LIKELY OWING TO MARGINAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /E.G. 20-30 KT WITHIN THE EFFECTIVE LAYER/ NOTED IN REGIONAL VWP DATA. WITH A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IN PLACE ACROSS THE MID-MS VALLEY INTO WRN TN/KY...OCCASIONAL UPWARD PULSES IN INTENSITY ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO RESULT IN ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. HOWEVER...LACK OF MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE MODE MAY LIMIT POTENTIAL FOR WIDESPREAD DMGG WIND GUSTS INTO THE EARLY EVENING. ..ROGERS.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS WITH SOME OF THEM FEATURING STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE GUSTS /50-65 MPH/ RESULTING IN ISOLD TO SCTD WIND DAMAGE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY AROUND 2145Z SHOWS AN ELONGATED LOOSELY CONNECTED MCS ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIANS FROM THE CUMBERLAND PLATEAU ENEWD THROUGH THE CUMBERLAND GAP AND INTO S-CNTRL VA. KMRX AND KFCX RADAR IMAGERY SHOW 50-KT AND 30-KT 3 KM ARL FLOW. KROA MEASURED A 52-KT GUST AT 2108Z. THE AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THE STORMS HAS HEATED WITH TEMPS AROUND 100 DEG F IN UPSTATE SC AND THE LOWER 90S IN THE TRI CITIES AREA. DEWPOINTS HAVE MIXED MORE IN UPSTATE SC WHERE TEMPS/DEWPOINT SPREADS ARE AROUND 30 DEG F AND 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES ARE AROUND 9 DEG C/KM. GIVEN THE STRONG BUOYANCY AND SUFFICIENTLY STRONG WLY FLOW FIELDS IN PLACE ACROSS THE REGION...SCATTERED 50+ MPH GUSTS /LOCALLY 60-65 MPH/ ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES IN THE MORE INTENSE CLUSTERS/SQUALL LINE. THERE IS RELATIVELY HIGH CONFIDENCE IN AN ISOLD TO SCTD WIND-DAMAGE THREAT AND A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY 2230Z FOR MUCH OF THIS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A VERY ISOLATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY EXIST THIS EVENING IN ASSOCIATION WITH DEVELOPING TSTMS OVER SRN IND. A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED JUST AHEAD OF A WEAK COLD FRONT MOVING TOWARDS THE LOWER OH VALLEY...AND NEAR AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLY-AFTERNOON CONVECTION. CONVERGENCE IS VERY WEAK ALONG THIS BOUNDARY AND THE COLD FRONT...WITH NEARLY UNIFORM WLY FLOW ACROSS THE REGION NOTED IN RECENT SFC OBS. HOWEVER...A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS FEATURING ESTIMATED MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3000 J/KG IS IN PLACE...AIDED BY SFC TEMPERATURES NEAR 90 F AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 70S F. WHILE COVERAGE IS LIKELY TO REMAIN VERY ISOLATED DUE TO WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND FORCING FOR ASCENT ALOFT...MODERATELY STRONG FLOW ABOVE 2 KM ARL IS YIELDING EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES OF 30-40 KT...WHICH WILL BE SUPPORTIVE FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS COULD ACCOMPANY ANY SUSTAINED STORM THAT DEVELOPS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED DISORGANIZED THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED GUSTS IN THE 55-70 MPH RANGE. OVERALL SPATIAL COVERAGE OF THE SEVERE THREAT WILL PROBABLY PRECLUDE A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS AN AREA OF SCATTERED STORMS FROM NEAR FST NNWWD INTO SERN NM AND MORE ISOLATED ACTIVITY FARTHER E DEVELOPING ON SUBTLE MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES. THE AIRMASS OVER THE REGION FEATURES TEMPS IN THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 100 DEG F WITH TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS AROUND 45 DEG F. AS A RESULT...VERY STEEP 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES /AROUND 9 DEG C PER KM/ ARE EVIDENT IN FORECAST SOUNDINGS AND THE STRONGER CORES WITH ENHANCED EVAPORATIVELY COOLED DOWNDRAFTS WILL POTENTIALLY BE CAPABLE OF 55-70 MPH GUSTS ON A LOCALIZED BASIS. RELATIVELY LIMITED STRENGTH OF THE FLOW DESPITE A STRONG DIRECTIONAL VEERING COMPONENT WILL LIKELY NEGATE A MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE-GUST RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE IS INCREASING ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...WITH AN ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED...AND A WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED STRONG TO SVR TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF NERN CO AND SERN WY...WITH RADAR TRENDS SUGGESTING LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST CORES. A MEASURED WIND GUST OF 62 MPH WAS ALSO REPORTED IN CHEYENNE WY. RECENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE FOCUSED ALONG COLLIDING BOUNDARIES ACROSS NERN CO. STRONG HEATING HAS RESULTED IN MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-2000 J/KG...AND STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WHICH MAY ENHANCE CONVECTIVE WIND POTENTIAL. THE PRIMARY ENVIRONMENTAL WEAKNESS IS THE PRESENCE OF 20-30 KT OF MIDLEVEL FLOW WHICH IS YIELDING MARGINAL EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES. HOWEVER...VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH HEIGHT...ESPECIALLY NEAR THE AFOREMENTIONED BOUNDARIES...MAY LOCALLY ENHANCE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. AN ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND SHOULD CONTINUE. LATEST HRRR RUNS SUGGEST A COUPLE LONGER-LIVED CLUSTERS COULD EVOLVE THIS EVENING AND MOVE EWD INTO SWRN NEB AND NWRN KS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED TO WIDESPREAD WIND DAMAGE IS POSSIBLE DUE TO PROBABLE SWATHS OF 50-70 MPH GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FAST-MOVING LINE SEGMENT IS MOVING EWD ACROSS NWRN NC AT AROUND 60 KT. THE BOUNDARY LAYER DOWNSTREAM IS CONSIDERED SUPPORTIVE FOR THE TRANSFER OF HIGHER-MOMENTUM FLOW TO THE SURFACE DUE IN PART TO THE STEEP LAPSE RATES. STRONG BUOYANCY AND SYSTEM-RELATIVE INFLOW /40 KT/ TO THE FORWARD PROPAGATING LINE SEGMENT WILL LIKELY RESULT IN LARGE SWATHS OF 50-70 MPH WINDS AND SCATTERED TO WIDESPREAD WIND DAMAGE FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT HOUR. ..SMITH.. 07/08/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE GUSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE MAY DEVELOP INTO NRN GA AND UPSTATE SC. A WATCH EXTENSION-IN-AREA WILL PROBABLY BE NEEDED UPSTATE SC AND FAR NERN GA IF A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS NOT ISSUED IN THE SHORT TERM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A LINE OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE SMOKY MTNS MOVING SEWD INTO FAR WRN NC. DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY THE AIRMASS IS CONSIDERED MODERATELY BUOYANT WITH MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG. ALTHOUGH FLOW FIELDS WEAKEN WITH SWRN EXTENT OVER NRN GA...KGSP VAD DATA SHOWS 20-40 KT FLOW IN THE 2-8 KM LAYER ATOP STEEP 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES /7-8 DEG C PER KM/. IN SUMMARY...IT SEEMS INCREASINGLY LIKELY A RISK FOR STRONG/LOW-END SEVERE GUSTS /50-60 MPH/ WILL MOVE INTO NERN GA AND UPSTATE SC.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL EXTEND INTO PARTS OF S-CNTRL KY AND MIDDLE TN OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED CLUSTER OF STORMS CONTINUES TO PROGRESS EWD ACROSS SWRN KY AND WRN TN...WITH MORE RECENT DEVELOPMENT INTO CHRISTIAN/TODD COUNTIES KY APPEARING TO BE ENHANCED BY EWD MOVING PORTION OF OUTFLOW. OTHER STRONG STORMS HAVE FLARED UP RECENTLY FARTHER S INTO WRN TN...AND TRENDS HAVE SHOWN MORE ORGANIZATION WITHIN THE PAST HR OR SO. BNA 00Z SOUNDING SAMPLED AN UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. SVR WIND GUST POTENTIAL APPEARS LIKELY TO PERSIST IN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS W OF I-65...WHERE THE AIR MASS IS RELATIVELY UNDISTURBED FROM EARLIER CONVECTION AND TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE UPPER 80S F. HOWEVER...WITH GENERALLY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR AND A SHORT TEMPORAL WINDOW FOR A SVR WIND THREAT...A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED STRONG THUNDERSTORM THREAT --PERHAPS BRIEFLY ACHIEVING SEVERE LEVELS ON A LOCALIZED BASIS-- WILL MOVE INTO THE S AND E SHORE AREAS OF LAKE ERIE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A POTENT MID-LEVEL LOW/TROUGH MIGRATING EWD ACROSS THE NRN GREAT LAKES AND FORCING FOR LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS PERTURBATION IS OVERSPREADING THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AT 01Z SHOW TEMPS HAVE COOLED INTO THE MID 70S OVER WRN NY AND NEAR 80 DEG F OVER NRN OH. ADDITIONAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING WILL OCCUR OWING TO THE LOSS OF HEATING AND BUOYANCY WILL LIKEWISE LESSEN WITH TIME. THE 00Z BUF RAOB SHOWED ONLY 250 J/KG MLCAPE WITH FAIRLY WEAK FLOW BELOW H7. IN CONTRAST...01Z OBJECTIVE ANALYSES IS CURRENTLY OVERESTIMATING BUOYANCY ACROSS THE REGION WITH 1000 J/KG MLCAPE NEAR BUF. ALTHOUGH SOME INCREASE IN FLOW/FORCING FOR ASCENT ARE EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AS THE UPPER TROUGH APPROACHES...A GRADUAL REDUCTION IN INSTABILITY WILL TEND TO LIMIT THUNDERSTORM STRENGTH. NONETHELESS...A LOW PROBABILITY FOR A STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE GUST WILL BE POSSIBLE NEAR THE MORE INTENSE CORES AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVES INTO THE AREA FROM THE W.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITHIN WW 362...PARTICULARLY FROM SWRN OK INTO NW TX. A FEW SVR WIND GUSTS MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THUNDERSTORMS SW OF THE WATCH TOWARDS THE MIDLAND AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW TSTM CLUSTERS REMAIN WITHIN WW 362...WITH THE STRONGEST OVER SWRN OK/NW TX AS OF 0130Z. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE GRADUALLY DECREASING OVER MOST OF THE REGION AS THE AIR MASS WHERE EARLIER TSTM DEVELOPMENT WAS FOCUSED HAS LARGELY BEEN OVERTURNED...AND THESE TRENDS SHOULD CONTINUE WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING. STRONG TO ISOLATED SVR DOWNBURST WINDS STILL REMAIN POSSIBLE IN ASSOCIATION WITH ANY SUSTAINED CONVECTION...AS EVIDENCED BY RECENT REPORTS OF 60-65 MPH WIND GUSTS SW OF FREDERICK OK. ADDITIONAL TSTMS HAVE ALSO DEVELOPED SW OF WW 362 TOWARDS THE MIDLAND TX AREA. WEAKER FLOW ALOFT IS RESULTING IN MORE PULSE-LIKE NATURE OF TSTMS ACROSS THIS AREA...BUT ISOLATED STRONG TO LOCALLY SVR WIND GUSTS MAY BE POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. A DRIER BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD RESULT IN MORE RAPID STABILIZATION WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING. ..ROGERS.. 07/09/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BROKEN SQUALL LINE WITH PRIMARILY STRONG THUNDERSTORM GUSTS WILL POTENTIALLY RESULT IN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE. ISOLATED GUSTS RANGING FROM 45-60 MPH ARE EXPECTED BUT THIS THREAT WILL PROBABLY BECOME INCREASINGLY LOCALIZED BY THE LATE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS 3 DISTINCT LINE SEGMENTS AS A PART OF A LARGER LINEAR CONVECTIVE COMPLEX MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS. INSTRUMENT-MEASURED GUSTS AT KGMU AND KAND IN UPSTATE SC MEASURED GUSTS OF 36-KT AND 37-KT...RESPECTIVELY...AND KAVL MEASURED A 38-KT GUST AROUND 0030Z. AS GRADUAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING OCCURS...THE ABILITY FOR ISOLD TO SCATTERED STRONG GUSTS WILL LIKELY DIMINISH. NONETHELESS...A VERY MOISTURE-RICH BOUNDARY LAYER OVER THE COASTAL PLAIN /UPPER 70S DEWPOINTS/ YIELDED 3400 J/KG MLCAPE ON THE 00Z CHS RAOB. IT IS POSSIBLE AS STORMS ENCOUNTER THE INCREASINGLY MOISTURE-RICH ENVIRONMENT OVER THE COASTAL PLAIN THAT STORMS MAINTAIN INTENSITY AND POSSIBLY STRENGTHEN. WATER-LOADED DOWNDRAFTS ARE EXPECTED TO THE PRIMARY MECHANISM FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AS 20-25 KT FLOW IN THE 1-3 KM LAYER MAY ACT TO LOCALLY ENHANCE WET MICROBURSTS. STRONG WIND GUSTS RANGING GENERALLY IN THE 40-55 MPH RANGE ARE EXPECTED BUT LOCALLY AROUND 60 MPH MAY BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES. AS A RESULT...STORMS MAY BE POTENTIALLY CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE AT LEAST ON A LOCALIZED BASIS FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR WIND DAMAGE DUE TO 40-60 MPH WINDS WILL EVENTUALLY SPREAD FROM THE PIEDMONT TO THE COAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE SAVANNAH RIVER VALLEY LOCATED ON THE SWRN EXTENSION OF A LONG-LIVED LINEAR MCS. A 32-KT GUST AT 0343Z WAS MEASURED AT KDNL NEAR THE GREATER AUGUSTA AREA. THE AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OVER E-CNTRL GA EWD TO THE SC LOWCOUNTRY AND GRAND STRAND IS CONSIDERED VERY MOIST WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER-MID 70S AND SURFACE TEMPS IN THE MID 80S AS OF 03Z. TEMPS WILL BE SLOW TO COOL THROUGH THE EARLY PART OF THE OVERNIGHT. MODIFYING THE 00Z CHS RAOB FOR AREA SURFACE CONDITIONS YIELDS A VERY UNSTABLE PROFILE WITH 3000 J/KG MLCAPE. RECENT VAD DATA FROM KCAE SHOWED STRENGTHENING WNWLY FLOW FROM 25 KT TO 45 KT IN THE PAST 1-2 HRS. FLOW FIELDS AT KCLX ARE BEGINNING TO SLOWLY INTENSIFY TOO WITH 30 KT AT 0.5 KM AGL. WILL MONITOR SHORT-TERM TRENDS FOR THE POSSIBILITY FOR ADDITIONAL STORM STRENGTHENING AND INSTRUMENTED SITES OVER THE SAVANNAH RIVER VALLEY FOR PEAK WIND GUSTS.
